Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Primary application owner/administrator authorized to generate activation codes and manage teacher accounts.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the primary administrator.

email.description: Verified Google email of the primary administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was last updated (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Teacher.title: Teacher
Teacher.description: Activated teacher account linked to a single-use activation code and managed by the primary administrator.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the teacher.

email.description: Verified Google email of the teacher.

teachingClass.description: Class taught by the teacher (e.g., X TP 1).

status.description: Account status controlled by the primary administrator.

activationCodeHash.description: Lowercase 64-character SHA-256 hex digest of the single-use activation code redeemed by this teacher.

activatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the teacher activated the account (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ActivationCode.title: ActivationCode
ActivationCode.description: Hashed single-use 7-day activation code issued exclusively by the primary administrator for teacher onboarding.

codeHash.description: Lowercase 64-character SHA-256 hex hash of the normalized activation code (matches document ID).

note.description: Optional administrator note describing the intended recipient.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the activation code.

createdByAdminUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who generated the code.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the code was generated (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

expiresAt.description: Expiration timestamp exactly 7 days after generation.

usedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the teacher who redeemed the code.

usedAt.description: Server timestamp when the code was redeemed (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

revokedAt.description: Server timestamp when an unused code was revoked by the administrator (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Primary administrator profile records; strictly restricted to the verified owner.

/teachers/{teacherUid}.description: Activated teacher accounts isolated by UID; readable by self or admin, status managed only by admin.

/activation_codes/{codeHash}.description: SHA-256 hashed single-use activation codes with 7-day expiry and atomic transaction redemption.
